title: ROADMAP-1: QNFO.REACH #PORTABILITY-RESTORE: follow-up filed with a closing probe
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=site/mydata.js
code-anchor: export async function ownerBundle

**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** weekly product-manager pass; the roadmap item is taken by the executor when it is next in driver order
**Program:** QNFO.REACH
**Metric it should move:** owner_load
**Cost rule:** adds no worker, cron or paid model call.
**Done check:** grep:site/mydata.js::restoreWebhooks ; merged and verified live: GET https://ultrastable.io/my-data/export expect "sign in first"
**Status:** closed

Restore connected apps and webhooks from an export, not only items. Bundle carries no secrets by design, so restore re-creates webhook subscriptions with fresh salts (shown once to the owner screen) and lists OAuth apps as 'reconnect' one-click links to /connect/<provider>. Prediction: a full export-then-restore on a clean instance leaves zero manual steps except consent clicks.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 157.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
